summary: First full-stack test of Rapid Express Logistics. Wrote 25 pytest cases covering auth, shipments CRUD, payment-before-movement rule, courier assign & flow, delivery proof, COD collection, public tracking, quotes, notifications, customer portal, role isolation, support tickets, audit log & analytics — all 25 PASS against the preview API. UI smoke test verified: landing page, invalid tracking (no crash), admin login redirects to /admin, dashboard shows stats + bar chart, and all admin sub-pages (shipments, quotes, couriers, customers, vehicles, support, audit) load without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 892-line module — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routes into feature modules (auth, shipments, courier, portal, admin) once features grow.
Cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for cross-site preview, but ensure production HTTPS is enforced.
analytics endpoint iterates all shipments in-memory to compute revenue/COD — fine for small data but consider MongoDB aggregation for scale.
GET /api/vehicles is available to any authenticated user (get_current_user) — customers/couriers can list vehicles. Likely benign but consider restricting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (7/7 pages load; admin login flow OK)

test_credentials: Admin johnsonsweay199@gmail.com / Rapid@2026. Test courier/customer accounts are created dynamically per pytest run with random suffix (prefix test_courier_/test_customer_).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run seeds: 1 test courier, 2 test customers, 1 vehicle, 2 shipments (prepaid + COD), 1 quote request, 1 support ticket — all with random uuid suffix so runs are idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope, but tests share module-level state (pytest.prepaid_id etc.) so all classes must run on the same worker — running with '-n 0' or ensuring loadscope keeps a single module together works. All 25 tests pass in ~7s. Frontend admin UI verified visually; courier & customer portal UIs were not deeply exercised via Playwright yet (only routing/protected redirects). Emails are lowercased on register/login — always compare using .lower().
